verdict.rationale: Dagster pipelines are defined as plain Python code (assets, jobs, schedules) scaffolded via CLI into a standard project structure that lives in a repo, is testable, and reviewable like normal software (dagster-docs-1, dagster-docs-2, dagster-docs-17, dagster-docs-18, dagster-docs-19, dagster-docs-26). Community feedback corroborates the Pythonic, code-first dev experience and CI/dev/prod portability goals (dagster-comm-2, dagster-comm-11). missing for 10: no explicit independent case study of code review workflows or repo-based version control practices beyond vendor docs.
